searchText: Thoughts on reducing staking rewards? 5M ETH staked is enough ... anything more is going to come through pools not individuals which is bad for security / regulatory capture As far as I know, the goal is still to aim for 8.3 million ETH to have enough validators for 64 shards. See https://github.com/ethereum/annotated-spec/blob/master/phase0/beacon-chain.md Awesome. After that reduce staking rewards? If the number of validators increases to far beyond that (say like 16 M ETH staked), I would say reducing staking rewards makes sense. Provided of course those numbers (64 shards, minimum target of 8.3 M ETH) are still relevant. There is definitely room for more research into what rewards makes sense, and also how the base rewards should be split up over the various validator duties. Thanks
